title: Neural Network From Scratch vs. PyTorch
description: Implement a multi-layer neural network with manual backpropagation, train it against an equivalent PyTorch implementation on the same data under identical seeds, and show loss curves match within tolerance — proving the gradients, not just the training loop.
learningObjectives: Implement forward and backward passes manually for an MLP
Match a PyTorch reference within numerical tolerance
Demonstrate overfitting and regularization effects with data

milestones.title: Manual forward pass + losses
milestones.objective: Implement linear layers, ReLU/tanh activations, and cross-entropy without autograd.
milestones.expectedOutput: Forward outputs match PyTorch within 1e-6 on seeded random inputs.

milestones.title: Manual backpropagation
milestones.objective: Derive and implement gradients for every layer; verify against finite differences, then against PyTorch autograd.
milestones.expectedOutput: Gradient-check tests pass with documented tolerances.

milestones.title: Matched training comparison
milestones.objective: Train both implementations with identical seeds, data order, and initialization; compare loss curves.
milestones.expectedOutput: Report with overlay plots and a stated equivalence tolerance.

milestones.title: Regularization experiments
milestones.objective: Show overfitting on a small dataset and mitigate with L2/dropout; document findings.
milestones.expectedOutput: Experiment table with train/val gaps before and after regularization.

categories.minimumExpectation: Gradient checks pass and loss tracks PyTorch within tolerance
Derivations for used activations and losses
categories.excellentExpectation: Each derivation linked to its code location
Walkthrough of a full training example

constraints: Identical seeds and data order in the comparison
hints: Implement gradient checks before training; failing loss equivalence almost always traces to one wrong derivative

requiredEvidence.description: Gradient-check and equivalence test output or CI link.
